name: Weather
author: Olivier Melcher
description: The World Clock weather detail panel on its own. Opens on your home location — the one Elsewhen (omarchy.elsewhen) considers home — and lists every Elsewhen location. Locations, home city, and units are read live from the Elsewhen widget in shell.json; weather comes from Open-Meteo.

barWidget.description: Detailed weather for your Elsewhen locations, opening on home.

schema.label: Weather refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: Network refresh period while the shell is running. Locations, home, and units come from the Elsewhen world clock, not from here.
